userInputText: The Dinosaur Game, also known as the "Chrome Dino" or "T-Rex Runner," is a popular side-scrolling endless runner game that can be played offline on Google Chrome when there's no internet connection. In this game, players control a pixelated T-Rex character who must navigate a desert landscape filled with cacti and flying pterodactyls. The objective is to survive for as long as possible by jumping over obstacles or crouching under them. Let's try and become the master of this engaging arcade game.FeaturesMinimalist designAddictive gameplayIncreases in difficulty as the player progresses
